testEnvironment:
Test environment: the snapshot is a git repository whose single commit holds
the reviewed tree — its tree hash was compared against the commit under review
when the snapshot was cut. A suite run here collects and runs what a checkout at
that commit does, so a failing or skipped test is a fact about the tree, not
about this copy of it. Its history is that one synthetic commit: 'git log',
'git diff' and every ancestry question answer about the snapshot and never about
the PR.
The Recipe's Test entrypoint and Check step do not run these merge-gating CI steps, and nothing in this review ran them: rebase-check job (pull_request-only branch-currency assertion, not meaningful in a worktree of origin/main); proc-macos job (node --test tests/proc.test.mjs on macOS) (subsumed by the full suite on this macOS host); smoke-omp job (needs pinned omp installed via bun, absent here); install-and-smoke job (needs pinned omp installed via bun and network, absent here).

unverified.claim: Several recorded review runs were degraded, but each record states the degradation. None is hidden or reported as clean, so I found no swallowed failure in the diff. The ledger's final #4368 row is the one case where nothing in the review.json records says why the run stopped.
unverified.evidence: Ran json.load over the 19 added review.json files. Four records have suiteVerdict.usable=False: 4351/run-9Q0NHFUF and run-P1RIsmQw ("no suite slot within 1800 s … not a test failure"), 4353/run-xy2V1z4M (same reason), and 4353/run-7v3E3LF1 ("the Install step did not run in the snapshot … so the shared test run was skipped"). 4356/run-LUvGgDKg also has usable=False, and its dimensionsUnrun lists 'tests' ("the reviewer returned nothing — spend limit, timeout, or terminal error"). 4353/run-Jz2ZE0E6 has usable=True but dimensionsUnrun lists 'correctness' with the same reason, so a green suite with one dimension unrun sits in a record marked usable. The ledger records the failures too (fix-pr-4351=failed, finisher-pr-4349=failed, finisher-pr-4374=halted:other, merge-bot-*=killed, dispositions-mismatch for fix-pr-4353).
unverified.suggested_fix: None needed for this PR. If a reader treats suiteVerdict.usable alone as 'review complete', it will miss unrun dimensions, because usable=True coexists with a non-empty dimensionsUnrun. That is a consumer concern, not something this diff introduces.
